reported.title: Wrong serial prefix and format for temperature line
reported.description: Line 34 prints "temp=" instead of the required "Temp: " prefix, so no line ever matches the required pattern. The measured evidence confirms no serial line matched /^Temp: -?[0-9]+\.[0-9]$/ in 8.00 s across all scenarios, including the nominal ramp. No serial line matched /^Temp: -?[0-9]+\.[0-9]$/ in 8.00 s; expected one every 1000 ms.

reported.title: Temperature value unparsable due to wrong prefix
reported.description: Because line 34 emits "temp=" rather than "Temp: ", the value regex /Temp: (-?[0-9.]+)/ never matches, so the printed value cannot be compared with A0. The measurement reports no parsable serial value in every scenario. No serial line matched /Temp: (-?[0-9.]+)/ so the printed value could not be compared with A0.

reported.title: Range lamp chatters at threshold with no hysteresis
reported.description: Line 28 compares the reported value against the bounds with a bare >=/<= test and no hysteresis, so analogRead noise and quantization around the threshold toggle D7 every loop. The measured evidence shows D7 in the wrong state for 3860 ms across 1571 intervals at the -10 C hover and 3564 ms across 1346 intervals with noise. D7 was in the wrong state for 3860 ms across 1571 interval(s), first at 501 ms: D7 was not LOW for 2 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

reported.title: Lamp follows live value during freeze and chatters at bounds
reported.description: Lines 52-55 re-latch frozenC from the live sample on every loop while D5 is LOW, so the hold does not freeze at the last pre-press value, and line 58 drives the lamp from that drifting value. Combined with the hysteresis-free comparison on line 28, the measured evidence shows D7 wrong for 3549 ms across 29 intervals during a long hold and 2941 ms across 1177 intervals at the 50 C hover. D7 was in the wrong state for 2941 ms across 1177 interval(s), first at 504 ms: D7 was not LOW for 1 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

serial values for 'Temp: (-?[0-9.]+)' match the stimulus (tolerance 1.5) (Value OK)

judge_input.spec:
- TMP36 on A0 (10 mV/°C with 500 mV offset); freeze button on D5 (pull-up); range lamp on D7.
- Every 1000 ms print exactly `Temp: <celsius>` with a space after the colon and one decimal place.
- Printed temperature must stay within ±1.5 °C of the injected probe value.
- While D5 is held LOW, freeze the reported value at the last sample.
- Light D7 when the reported temperature is outside -10.0 to 50.0 °C.
- Also print `weather n=<samples>` each second after the Temp line.
